content.comment_body: I'm attempting to toggle an analog network input by reading a configurable output pin on the TRB246 device. TRB returns that the request is successful, but my [product_name] system doesn't react to it. Details of the TRB pin: ADDRESS / REGISTER NUMBER / NUMBER OF REGISTERS / REPRESENTATION Output (PIN4) 325 326 1 as a 16-bit unsigned integer.
The TRB pin is located within a holding register, verified using Modbus poll.
Could you share your [product_name] program configuration?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing difficulty integrating [product_name] with an external TRB246 device through Modbus. Although the TRB246 provides a successful request response, the [product_name] device fails to register or respond to the network input. Initial troubleshooting—including verification with Modbus poll—shows communication is happening, but the root configuration or communication issue has not been resolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable and real-time Modbus communication between the TRB246 and the [product_name] system to achieve consistent toggling of the analog input via the network.
